items.title: Dave Bailey and John McNeil Interview, 1959-10-25
items.q: Clannett, he played Clannett in sax. That's Kaiser.

ctx.x: Willie Jones was one of the great, great Clannett brothers. I don't know if you knew him. I know his brother. I know John. John, yeah. John, I played with John. Well I played with John too. Yeah, but I'm talking about the one that John's playing. I'm trying to get him in this outfit that I'm getting together now on the bass. Well I take a few lessons from his brother Willie. Yeah, he's good. And he was a real good drunk man. Well voiced on music. Yeah, read music. Read real good.
Clannett, he played Clannett in sax. That's Kaiser.
That's the one that got killed by the car. They call him Kaiser.
